title: THE KILLING OF COLONEL CALLAN: Feature Film / 4-Part Limited Series
description:
THE KILLING OF COLONEL CALLAN is a dynamic, action-filled true-crime drama set

on the streets of the U.K. and the battlefields of the Angolan Civil War. The 4-part drama centres on the trial of 13 mercenaries for the murder of 14 of their own men during the

height of the Cold War. Combining the toxic chaos of THE NORTH WATER, with the

chilling brutality of BEASTS OF NO NATION, THE KILLING OF COLONEL CALLAN is

a fascinating exploration into the extremes of survival in the most hostile of war-zones.


Available materials: Pilot Script, Pitch Deck / Treatment.
